defective_pattern: Placing headings directly underneath body text without an explicit preceding blank line or skipping blank lines in DOCX generators.
why_defective: Violates Iranian thesis guidelines, disrupts document visual hierarchy, and fails supervisor formatting checks.
observed_symptoms: Absence of empty line before section/subsection titles
corrective_remedy: Insert exactly one blank newline before each heading in Markdown and enforce an explicit blank line separation in OpenXML DOCX.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of heading syntax (#, ##) immediately following a non-empty text string without an intervening newline character (\n\n).
